name: Ushba Cost & Margin Reports for WooCommerce
author: ushbakhan

sections.description:
Ushba Cost & Margin Reports for WooCommerce helps store owners understand whether orders are actually profitable.

WooCommerce shows sales totals, but many small stores still track product costs and gross margin in spreadsheets. Ushba Cost & Margin Reports adds unit cost fields to WooCommerce products and variations, calculates order-level cost and margin snapshots, and provides a date-filtered admin report.

Features

  • Unit cost field for WooCommerce products.
  • Unit cost field for WooCommerce product variations.
  • Gross margin snapshots for WooCommerce orders.
  • Date-filtered margin dashboard.
  • Net revenue, product cost, gross margin, and margin-rate totals.
  • Recent order table with margin values.
  • Recalculate orders after updating product costs.
  • Optional data deletion on uninstall.
  • StoreMargin Pro upgrade flow powered by the official Freemius SDK.

Pro Features

StoreMargin Pro is planned for:

  • Product profitability reports.
  • Variation reports.
  • Category reports.
  • Bulk cost tools.
  • CSV import/export.
  • Low-margin alerts.
  • Scheduled reports.

Privacy

Ushba Cost & Margin Reports stores product cost values and calculated order margin summaries in the local WordPress database. The plugin does not send data to the plugin author or any external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ushba-cost-margin-reports-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Add unit costs to WooCommerce products from the product edit screen.
  5. Open Tools > Ushba Cost & Margin Reports.
  6. Recalculate orders for the selected date range.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. The margin dashboard and product cost fields require WooCommerce.

Does this replace accounting software?

No. Ushba Cost & Margin Reports provides operational gross-margin reporting inside WordPress. It is not tax, accounting, or financial advice.

Does it send store data anywhere?

The free reporting data is stored locally. Freemius powers licensing, opt-in, account, checkout, and update workflows for the optional Pro version.

What costs are included?

The free version calculates product cost using the unit cost saved on each product multiplied by order item quantity. It subtracts refunds, taxes, shipping, and order fees from revenue for a practical gross-margin snapshot.

What happens on uninstall?

Data is retained by default. If you enable “Delete product cost and order margin data when this plugin is uninstalled,” uninstalling removes the plugin’s product and order metadata.

0.1.3

  • Regenerated release packages with strict WordPress-compatible ZIP structure validation.
  • Added release safeguards for UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, PHP syntax, and Plugin Check validation.

0.1.2

  • Added unit cost fields for WooCommerce product variations.
  • Improved free foundation for stores with variable products.
  • Added official Freemius SDK integration for StoreMargin.
  • Added protected StoreMargin Pro pages for product, variation, category, bulk cost, CSV, alert, and scheduled report workflows.
  • Moved CSV import/export behind StoreMargin Pro licensing.

0.1.1

  • Initial release candidate.
  • Added WooCommerce product unit cost field.
  • Added order-level margin snapshots.
  • Added margin dashboard, date filters, CSV export, and recalculation.
  • Added uninstall data retention setting and privacy policy content.
